description: Get progress and result of an asynchronous job. 生成类动作（topic_generate / paper_draft_one_click / …）提交后返回 job_id（engine_status=queued），用这个工具轮询：每 3 秒查一次，最多等 300 秒；status=succeeded 取 result，failed 读 error（失败不扣分）。US English: poll a queued generation job until succeeded/failed.
